condition_rows.rule: PBOC Art. 37 defines domestic individuals by PRC ID/military papers and foreign individuals by passport/HK/Macau/Taiwan travel documents; Decree 532 Art. 52 uses a separate one-year residence definition. Do not infer classification from nationality alone; use the bank's account/identity classification.
USD50,000 is an annual convenience purchase/settlement quota, not a hard cap on genuine lawful current-account transactions; above it requires ID plus transaction-amount/source or purpose documents.
A foreign individual with lawful current-account RMB income may purchase FX and remit with ID and supporting/tax documents; unused inward FX may be remitted back with ID.
No splitting, borrowed quotas, false documents or private swap channels. Hui Fa [2015] No. 49 imposes a watch list for the listing year and two following years.

Individual FX purchase/sale must use qualified banks or authorized exchange agencies; company/app/social-media/broker/underground-bank channels are unlawful. Virtual-currency-related exchange and settlement business is also prohibited.

For service-trade and other specified outbound payments, a single payment above USD50,000 requires tax filing; the unchanged amount standard is USD50,000, and for one contract with multiple payments filing occurs only when the first payment exceeds it.

Domestic-individual FX-savings remittance ≤USD50,000/day uses ID; above that needs genuine current-account documents. Foreign-individual FX-savings remittance uses ID. ICBC's product page repeats these rules.
If funds are in a foreign-currency cash account rather than a remittance account, ICBC and CCB describe a cash-to-remittance spread charged at the day's board rate; include it in a written quote.

CNY100,000 per person per calendar year across own cards and CNY10,000 per card per day; exceeding the annual cap suspends current and next-year overseas cash withdrawals. Ordinary card consumption is unaffected and does not consume the USD50,000 convenience quota.

Foreign-currency cash: ≤USD5,000 permit-free, USD5,000–10,000 bank permit, >USD10,000 generally prohibited except special SAFE permit. RMB cash limit is CNY20,000 per person per trip. Entering/leaving the US with more than USD10,000 in currency/monetary instruments requires FinCEN Form 105; group aggregation applies.

Foreign employees participate in five insurances. On departure before pension age the personal account is retained; only a written application to terminate the social-insurance relation permits a one-time payment of the personal-account balance. The 2024 amendment changes eligibility-document names and annual overseas eligibility verification.

US citizens/resident aliens remain on worldwide-income filing rules; personal FX gain over USD200 is a capital gain; FTC uses Form 1116 and cannot apply to excluded income; FBAR aggregate foreign accounts >USD10,000 and Form 8938 have separate thresholds; FEIE requires a foreign tax home and residence/presence test.

playbooks.title: Default: documented foreign-individual after-tax income bank wire
playbooks.summary: Use a licensed bank, your own overseas account, and source-of-funds/tax evidence; do not treat the USD50,000 convenience quota as a blanket permission.
playbooks.quote_gate: Request a written same-time all-in quote: FX selling rate, commission, telegram, cash-to-remittance spread, full-arrival charge, intermediary/receiving deductions and expected final recipient amount.
unknowns: Current executable FX rate and all-in fee
Personal acquisition basis for any FX gain

steps.text: Confirm the bank's classification of the account holder from identity documents; a US passport holder is normally a foreign individual under PBOC Art. 37, but Decree 532 has a separate residence definition.
Assemble passport/work eligibility, lawful source-of-funds records, PRC personal income-tax records and the overseas account in your own name.
Use only a qualified bank or authorized exchange institution; do not use a private swap, borrowed quota, false invoice or underground-bank channel.

Present the genuine current-account purpose and transaction-amount documents. If the bank applies the USD50,000 convenience quota, above-quota genuine transactions require documents rather than splitting.

Request a written same-time all-in quote before irrevocable instructions: FX selling rate, commission, telegram, cash-to-remittance spread, full-arrival charge, intermediary/receiving deductions and expected final recipient amount.
Confirm whether funds are cash-account or remittance-account FX; cash-account funds can incur an additional spread.
Use an own-account wire with accurate recipient details; retain the FX memo, tax records, bank receipt and any tax-filing number/verification code.
After settlement, check US worldwide-income filing, FBAR/Form 8938, any realized FX gain over USD200, and FTC/FEIE interactions with a qualified tax adviser.

playbooks.title: Domestic-individual genuine current-account purchase above USD50,000
playbooks.summary: Only if the bank classifies you as a domestic individual; the convenience quota is not a hard cap on documented genuine transactions.
playbooks.quote_gate: All-in written quote plus the bank's document checklist; do not split to avoid documentation.

steps.text: Ask the bank to confirm the legal classification; do not assume a US passport or long residence decides it.
Identify the genuine current-account purpose and collect ID plus transaction-amount/source or purpose evidence.
Use the USD50,000 annual convenience quota only for ID-only processing; above the quota, present genuine-transaction documents instead of splitting.
Do not borrow another person's quota or use false documents; the watch-list period is the listing year plus two following years.
Request a written all-in quote from the licensed bank, including cash-to-remittance spread and downstream deductions.
Keep the bank's classification memo, documents and receipt for later US reporting and any PRC tax review.

playbooks.title: Service-trade / income / current-transfer payment with tax filing
playbooks.summary: For a genuine contract-based outbound payment, not a workaround for moving personal savings.
playbooks.quote_gate: Tax-filing number/verification code plus a written bank quote; current cost blank until both exist.
unknowns: Whether the transaction is in the filing scope

steps.text: Characterize the underlying contract and payment; do not invent a service contract to move personal principal.
Check the USD50,000 single-payment tax-filing threshold: an unexceeded single payment does not require filing under Announcement 2021 No. 19's unchanged standard.
For one contract with multiple payments, file only before the first payment that exceeds USD50,000; do not file again for every later payment on the same contract.
File online through the electronic tax bureau or obtain the paper form at a tax hall; record the form number and verification code.
Give the number and verification code to the bank and follow FX authenticity/document review; the tax hall need not complete a substantive tax review at filing.
Request a written all-in bank quote and compare the final recipient amount, not just the visible fee.
Retain the contract, filing, tax-payment evidence, bank receipt and US reporting records.

playbooks.title: Regulated provider route (Wise or SkyRemit)
playbooks.summary: Use only when eligible work-status, after-tax income records, own-account destination and the supported corridor all fit.
playbooks.quote_gate: Compare final recipient amount at the same send amount, currency and quote time; do not convert a dynamic display into a durable price.
unknowns: Current variable fee and FX markup

steps.text: Confirm non-mainland-Chinese eligibility, valid work/ID documents and a tax record showing tax paid within the provider's accepted three-year window.
Confirm the recipient is your own overseas account and the purpose is personal, documented after-tax salary/income.
Check per-transfer limits: SkyRemit 500–300,000 CNY; Wise bank app CNY300,000 and Alipay CNY50,000. Wise also applies a tax-record-based overall limit.
For SkyRemit, record the CNY79 fixed fee, the variable percentage fee, the XE-based visible markup, and the 0.8% Alipay/WeChat channel fee; bank transfer has no channel fee.
Read the rate-lock terms: displayed rates are indicative, the actual rate locks at Confirm Rate, actual debit may differ, and receiving-country taxes/fees are excluded.
Do not submit irrevocable instructions until the quote page shows the expected final recipient amount; take a screenshot and retain the order record.
For a fair comparison, use the same send amount, destination currency, quote time and recipient route; ask explicitly about intermediary/receiving-bank deductions.
Complete US reporting after receipt; provider convenience does not remove worldwide-income, FBAR or Form 8938 analysis.

playbooks.title: Foreign-employee social-insurance account closure
playbooks.summary: A narrow statutory payout, not a general method to extract a CNY bank balance.
playbooks.quote_gate: Written termination application and social-insurance agency determination; no transfer quote until the balance and lawful-source documents exist.
unknowns: Whether the bank will accept the resulting funds for FX conversion

steps.text: Confirm participation in the five social insurances and identify the personal-account balance with the social-insurance agency.
If departing before pension age, note that the account is retained and contribution years accumulate on return; departure alone does not create a lump sum.
Only after a written application to terminate the social-insurance relation may the personal-account balance be paid once to the individual.
For overseas monthly-benefit eligibility, observe the annual verification rule as amended in 2024.
Treat any one-time payout as a separate source-of-funds event; obtain written tax and bank documentation before attempting conversion/remittance.
Use a licensed bank and own-account wire; do not use a private channel or mistakenly label the payout as salary.
Record the payout in the US reporting analysis; do not assume a social-insurance refund is exempt.

playbooks.title: FIE dividend / business distribution
playbooks.summary: Characterize the income first; a distribution is not a transfer of existing personal principal and is not a transfer tax.
playbooks.quote_gate: Corporate resolution, withholding evidence, tax-filing number/verification code where required, and a written all-in bank quote; current cost blank.
unknowns: Applicable domestic rate and treaty relief
US tax outcome under the saving clause

steps.text: Determine whether the payment is a dividend, interest, royalty, service payment or liquidation proceeds; the tax and FX documents differ.
For foreign individuals receiving FIE dividends from 2026-09-01, apply the 20% IIT rate under MOF/STA Announcement 2026 No. 27; the prior exemption is repealed.
For a nonresident enterprise, EIT implementation regulations Art. 91 states a reduced 10% rate for specified income; do not apply this to an individual automatically.
Read the US–China treaty Articles 9, 10 and 11 (dividends, interest, royalties) 10% gross caps, Article 22 double-tax relief, and Protocol 1 paragraph 2 allowing the US to tax its citizens.
Do not assume treaty relief overrides domestic withholding; obtain a qualified cross-border tax determination and supporting residency/beneficial-owner documents.
If a single outbound payment exceeds USD50,000 and is in the tax-filing scope, obtain the tax-filing number/verification code before the bank processes it.
Use a licensed bank, own-account or properly documented beneficiary, and a written all-in quote; retain withholding and bank records for US FTC analysis.

playbooks.title: Emigration or inheritance property transfer
playbooks.summary: Special SAFE-approved capital route for a narrowly defined property transfer; not a salary or savings workaround.
playbooks.quote_gate: SAFE approval reply and verification document, tax certificate, then a written bank quote; current cost blank.

steps.text: Confirm the case fits emigration or inheritance property transfer under PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16; ordinary personal savings do not fit.
Apply to the competent SAFE office with identity, property-title, source-of-funds/property-sale and tax-certificate documents.
For emigration property, observe the staged remittance rule: first no more than half, then staged further amounts after one and two years, unless the total is ≤CNY200,000.
Obtain the SAFE approval reply and capital-account FX verification document; the designated bank must remit directly to the applicant's own overseas account.
Do not withdraw foreign-currency cash domestically as a substitute for the approved remittance.
Request a written all-in bank quote and retain the approval chain for later PRC/US tax and reporting review.

playbooks.title: Cash, card and ATM boundaries (not a USD400,000 execution route)
playbooks.summary: Use these rules only to reject an unlawful shortcut or to plan ordinary travel cash, not to move the full balance.
playbooks.quote_gate: No all-in quote is inferred; cash/ATM amounts, surcharges and declarations are fact-specific.

steps.text: Foreign-currency cash ≤USD5,000 is permit-free; USD5,000–10,000 needs a bank permit; >USD10,000 is generally prohibited except special SAFE permit.
RMB cash carried across the border is limited to CNY20,000 per person per trip under PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 18.
Overseas ATM cash withdrawals are capped at CNY100,000 per person per calendar year and CNY10,000 per card per day; exceeding the annual cap suspends current and next-year withdrawals.
Ordinary overseas card consumption is unaffected by the ATM rule and does not use the USD50,000 convenience purchase quota, but it is not a conversion of the bank balance into a US deposit.
UnionPay says local currency is converted to CNY at a market rate; ATM-owner surcharges and local machine limits can apply. Debit cards are generally preferable to credit for cash.
Entering or leaving the US with more than USD10,000 in currency/monetary instruments requires FinCEN Form 105; family/group amounts are aggregated.
Do not use crypto/stablecoin P2P as a workaround; PRC regulators classify virtual-currency exchange and related business activities as illegal financial activity.

playbooks.title: After every route: US tax and reporting wrapper
playbooks.summary: Moving your own principal is not itself new income, but it does not prove zero tax or eliminate reporting.
playbooks.quote_gate: No quoted amount; personal basis, residency and account maxima are facts that only the taxpayer can supply.

steps.text: Check worldwide gross income against the filing rules for US citizens/resident aliens living abroad; the place of residence does not remove the filing framework.
Measure any realized personal foreign-currency gain; gains over USD200 are reported as capital gain, but acquisition basis and rate are personal facts.
Check FBAR when aggregate foreign financial accounts exceed USD10,000 at any time in the calendar year; Form 8938 has separate residence/status thresholds.
If foreign tax was paid on the same income, evaluate Form 1116; no foreign tax credit is allowed for tax on income excluded under FEIE/FHE.

Evaluate FEIE only after confirming foreign earned income, a foreign tax home and bona fide residence or physical-presence test; the exclusion does not make the income disappear from a required return.
For treaty positions, read Article 22 and the saving clause; do not treat the treaty as a blanket exemption for a US citizen.
Keep the source-of-funds file, bank/provider quote, rate lock, receipts, tax filings and account statements together for the preparer.

irregularities.finding: The exact 2026-11-09 05:30 Beijing BOC USD row used by the inherited model is no longer on the rolling board; historical date search returns a captcha/error. On 2026-11-10 14:09:58 Beijing the board showed USD 665.84 / 668.64 per 100 and a Middle Rate of 671.67.
irregularities.action: Treat the inherited BOC rate as a benchmark, obtain a written rate confirmation, and keep current executable quote blank.

irregularities.finding: The observed Middle Rate 671.67 is not the arithmetic midpoint of the displayed buy/sell 665.84/668.64 (667.24). The inherited model computes its own midpoint.
irregularities.action: Do not substitute BOC's Middle Rate for the model's own midpoint; ask BOC to confirm the published definition before execution.

irregularities.finding: The ABC price table's discount note says listed free/discount items apply from 2026-09-30 until the price directory expires; a separate general announcement has a 2025-12-15 date in search snippets. The two should not be conflated.

irregularities.finding: CMB's official dynamic price catalogue and directory say content is for reference and local branch notices/rules apply; no stable personal outward-wire row was exposed to the text fetcher.

irregularities.finding: PBOC Art. 37 defines domestic/foreign individuals by identity documents; Decree 532 Art. 52 defines domestic individual by citizenship or continuous residence for one year. These are different instruments and contexts.
irregularities.action: Do not infer classification from nationality or residence alone; get the bank's classification memo and qualified legal review.

irregularities.finding: MOF/STA 2026 No. 27 imposes 20% IIT on foreign individuals' FIE dividends from 2026-09-01, while the US–China treaty has 10% gross caps in Arts. 9–11 and a saving clause. Domestic and treaty positions need expert reconciliation.
irregularities.action: Do not assume an automatic treaty reduction; obtain a written cross-border tax determination before payment.

irregularities.finding: The one-time social-insurance personal-account payment requires a written application to terminate the relation; departure alone retains the account and accumulates contribution years on return.

build_checks: python3 scripts/build_bank_playbooks.py -- writes banks.html, playbooks.html and verification.html from data/bank-playbooks.json and data/cost-model.json.

python3 scripts/validate_bank_playbooks.py -- checks JSON source references, canonical facts, 40 amount rows, blank quote cells, every table row's source link, playbook step citations, local links, anchors, landmarks and balanced HTML.
Generated-diff check -- rebuild twice and compare byte-for-byte; no timestamps or random values are emitted.
Negative controls -- remove a source link, fill a blank quote with a numeric value, mutate a canonical fee, or drop a playbook step; each mutation must make the validator fail.
Local HTTP smoke test -- serve the repository and request the three new pages, the seven inherited pages, redirects, CSS and data files; each should return 200.
